title: Establish declarations, image, capture, and managed documents
description:
Create the final neutral `declarations` and `repository_state` crate-root modules — the pure, filesystem-free foundation every later package builds on. This package introduces the canonical declaration types, the closed repository image and capture model, typed intents/deltas, and the strict managed-document engine, and deletes the superseded definitions from the staging tree as their final consumers move in.

## Background

JIT repository mutations currently derive coupled persisted state — default rule membership, default schemas, rendered projections, managed prose regions, profile provenance, and audit — across command-specific paths that can silently diverge from declared configuration. The consolidation replaces those paths with two pure modules. `declarations` owns neutral gate/rule declarations and a filesystem-free config parser. `repository_state` owns canonical paths, the closed `RepositoryImage`, the bounded `CaptureSpec`, typed intents/deltas, the materialization producers, and the managed-document engine. This package establishes the pure derivation core only; the layout-aware store, typed mutation, materializers, and consumer migration land in later packages on the same integration branch.

## What to build

- `declarations` (crate root, exported from `lib.rs`): pure owner of `GateRegistry`, the renamed `GateDefinition`, `RuleSet`, `Rule`, their assertion/checker value types, and authored-registry parse/preservation structures; plus the pure configuration parser — a filesystem-free, validation-free function from captured `config.toml` bytes to typed configuration components (hierarchy, namespaces, item kinds, projections, documentation roots). Imports neither validation, storage, commands, nor profile.
- `repository_state` (crate root, exported from `lib.rs`): `RepositoryLayout`, `VirtualPath`, `RepositoryEntry`, `RepositoryImage`, `RepositorySeed`, `MaterializationIntent`, `TargetClaim`, `RepositoryDelta`, pinned-document and linked-worktree evidence types, the two-phase `CaptureSpec` model, the managed-document containment engine, and pure derive/compare signatures. Imports only `declarations`/config — never validation, storage, commands, or profile. Producer composition is a closed direct pure call graph, not a provider list, callback registry, or extension seam.
- Canonical layout and virtual-path authority: construct `RepositoryLayout` once from no-follow, lexically normalized worktree and selected data roots; accept only disjoint roots or a data root strictly nested beneath the worktree; reject `data_root == worktree_root`, ancestor data roots, symlinked root components, and lexical escape as typed errors (`OverlappingRepositoryRoots`, `DataRootAlias`). `VirtualPath` is `Worktree(rel)`/`Data(rel)` over `RootRelativePath::{Root, Descendant}`. One `classify_and_canonicalize` is the sole physical/repository-relative conversion, applying Data precedence for nested subtrees and proving virtual-to-physical injectivity. Reserve the `Worktree(Descendant(".jit-bootstrap/..."))` and `Data(Descendant("tmp/..."))` transaction-control namespaces so they are never valid semantic targets, capture entries, or destinations.
- Two-phase bounded `CaptureSpec` and `RepositoryImage`: phase one reads fixed `Data(...)` declaration roots plus the typed command/profile seed; phase two runs a no-follow work-queue fixpoint under explicit path/count/byte/depth budgets, recording exact entry identities and complete-listing fingerprints keyed by `VirtualPath`, and never recursively scanning either root, build trees, or Git metadata. Capture closure enqueues every unpinned issue document, validation-read asset, parent preimage, and derived planning-node plan path; pinned documents and linked-worktree fallback reads resolve only into boundary-acquired typed evidence carrying source class, identity (commit/blob OID or no-follow file identity + hash), and exact bytes or a typed absence. A pure producer requesting an uncaptured path fails with `UndiscoveredRepositoryPath` and cannot perform I/O or treat the path as absent. The plan hash covers layout identity, normalized `CaptureSpec`, the injectivity proof, every entry/listing/pinned-evidence identity, typed seed, and exact delta.
- Strict managed-document engine: one byte-oriented target-claim engine that collects all claims before rendering, allows at most one base claim, builds a containment tree, and rejects partial, duplicate same-identity, reversed, crossing, multiply-owned, competing-base, or ambiguous structures while preserving well-formed distinct-identity nesting and every unmanaged byte byte-for-byte. It accepts explicit append-if-absent versus require-existing placement policies; placement stays canonical claim metadata.

Distilled §2 contracts: neutral declaration authority, final neutral state subsystem, final layout/overlap/virtual-path authority, two-phase bounded capture, document and planning closure, pinned document evidence, capture coherence and revalidation, and managed-document composition. See `dev/active/cdc840ad-plan.md` §2 and plan decisions D2, D3, D8, D14 for full detail.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Pure unit/harness tests pass covering: CaptureSpec closure with `UndiscoveredRepositoryPath` rejection for uncaptured reads; layout alias/overlap rejection (equal roots, ancestor data root, Worktree-under-Data alias, symlink/lexical escape) as typed errors; managed-document containment acceptance of well-formed distinct-identity nesting and rejection of duplicate, reversed, crossing, multiply-owned, and competing-base structures; and plan-hash determinism (identical image+seed+delta yields an identical hash; any entry, listing, or seed change yields a different hash). `declarations` and `repository_state` compile with no imports from validation, storage, commands, or profile.
- [hard] REQ-02: Old definitions are removed from the staging tree when their final consumers move here; no bridge or selectable engine is added.

## Constraints

- Long-term boundaries only: no re-export, provider/callback seam, ambient read, whole-repository recursion, name alias, or selectable/dual engine.
- Cumulative, final-form commits on branch `integration/cdc840ad`; never merged to main individually. Each commit runs the targeted tests for this package plus all prior cumulative package tests for every affected crate.
- Expose only the final interfaces the next package requires — no adapter, feature flag, compatibility re-export, dual path, or temporary API.
- Old definitions deleted from the staging tree as their final consumers move in: `storage::GateRegistry`, the broad-domain `Gate` name, `validation::rules::{RuleSet, Rule}`, the `validation::repository` byte-only view, and `profile::snapshot` — no old-name alias survives.
- Out of scope (plan D19/D20): lease credential/claim-log/claim-command redesign, and any worktree/data-root binding redesign that would make a disjoint root an adoptable repository.

Blast radius: declarations, `repository_state` pure types and producers, validation view seams, profile image/marker primitives, and unit/harness fixtures.
